title: Broncos activated TE Caleb Lohner from the IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos activated TE Caleb Lohner from the IR
sources.description: According to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, the Denver Broncos have activated tight end Caleb Lohner from the injured reserve. Lohner will be at practice today, and this opens his 21-day practice window, during which the Broncos have to decide whether or not to add him to the active roster or keep him on the injured […]
